probesCount.description:
This parameter specifies the number of clusters to search in the inverted index during the query phase. Increasing
the number of probes can improve search accuracy by exploring more clusters, but it also increases search time.

title: Represents the vector/text similarity search performance tuning parameters for the IvfFlat index method.
